description: Create a word-search puzzle (sopa de letras) from a list of words. Puzzles up to 10x10 with at most 10 words are free and unlimited; bigger ones use the free puzzles each client gets. Keeps native letters (Ñ, Ç, Ã, Ä, ẞ, È…) as one cell each. Returns the grid, where every word is hidden, and any words that did not fit. Empty cells are marked "-": call fill_word_search with the grid to complete it with random letters. The same seed always gives the same puzzle.

classicMode.description: Strip accents in the grid (ñ becomes N).

clustering.description: 0 keeps words apart, 1 makes them cross. Default 0.5.

cols.description: Grid width. May differ from rows for a rectangular grid.

difficulty.description: Used when position is not set: 1 easy (right, down) to 4 expert (all 8 directions).

lang.description: Language of the words. Default es.

position.description: horizontal = left to right only, vertical = top to bottom only, mixed = all 8 directions including diagonals.

seed.description: Repeatable puzzles: same input and seed, same grid.

words.description: Words to hide, in their normal spelling (accents kept).

name: generate_word_search
title: Generate a word search
